hypotheses.title: Betting Against Beta (BAB) Anomaly with Short-Term Reversion Overlay
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits the classic Betting Against Beta (BAB) anomaly across TOP3000 subindustries. Leverage-constrained institutional investors systematically overpay for high-beta stocks, depressing their risk-adjusted returns relative to low-beta peers. Applying quadratic power scaling concentrates capital into the lowest-beta deciles, while a 15% 3-day delta reversal overlay provides execution timing with ultra-low turnover (<15%) and zero correlation to option volatility alphas.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if low-beta stocks underperform during speculative growth rallies.

candidates.rationale: Power-scaled 360-day low-beta anomaly with 15% 3-day close reversal
Quality-Minus-Beta: Top fundamental quality minus systematic 360-day beta

hypotheses.title: Fundamental Quality & Analyst Revision Momentum with Tail Scaling
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Blends registered fundamental quality scores (fscore_bfl_quality) with positive analyst consensus revision derivatives within subindustries. Tail-power scaling concentrates weight on high-quality companies receiving consensus upgrades, while a 15% 3-day price reversal captures short-term liquidity concessions.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if revision momentum is immediately priced in by the market.

candidates.rationale: Power-scaled fundamental quality plus analyst revision derivative with 15% reversal
